AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Vegetables? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Vegetables.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Vegetables.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Vegetables.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Vegetables.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food Frying Frying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming Practices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Repai and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Home Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Laundering Cotton Item and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
